intro: Over 21 articles published between April 13 and April 30, 2026, examined privilege-escalation vulnerabilities, with 18 classified as high severity and two as critical. The threat actor Chaotic Eclipse was observed in these incidents, while the most notable CVEs included CVE-2026-40372 (CVSS 9.1), CVE-2026-5490 (CVSS 8.8), CVE-2026-6406 (CVSS 8.8), CVE-2026-25203 (CVSS 7.8), and CVE-2026-31431 (CVSS 7.8). Affected sectors spanned technology, education, enterprise, and healthcare, with global and North American regions impacted.
